events.title: Null Path update v0.3.3
events.summary: What's insideThis is the final major update that brings Null Path to it's near completion! All of the levels, traps, jumps, puzzles and enemies are now created - the last remaining updates before release will only be bug fixes and small improvements based on player feedback. Plus a nice intro. And maybe a nice outro.TON OF NEW LEVELS 3 new biomes Factory, Ruins & a third secret biome! 21 new levels + multi-levels + hidden levelsSecret biome only unlockable through egg huntingNEW POWERUP Stasis -

events.title: Null Path update v0.2.2
events.summary: What's inside STORY AND LORE added hidden lore around the game, waiting to be discovered NEW BIOME - The Null 15 new levels new hidden mechanics with their own puzzles to solve new enemies (grimreapers, skeleton dogs, skeleton archers) NEW POWERUP Aura ring of vision see hidden platforms/obstacles see into the null realm (careful of hidden enemies) hidden NPCs NEW MECHANICS checkpoint system - create a clone of yourself once per screen difficulty selection system introduced tied to checkpointing

events.title: Null Path Beta Launch!
events.summary: Hey everyone! After months of hard work, level design, and countless difficult jumps, I’m excited to finally launch a fully playable Beta of Null Path! This game has been a labor of love, inspired by my passion for challenging platformers and puzzles alike. I wanted to create something that blends precise platforming with thoughtful and environmental puzzles, all wrapped in a minimalist, metroidvania style world.
